## Calculate award timeliness metrics for an individual award, or for an agency or branch.

- Time between Award Notification and First Day of Award (in days) = \[Proposal Award Date minus Date of Notification\]

The query is passed through to the configured backend, so operators such as site:domain, filetype:pdf, intitle:word, -term, and "exact phrase" may work when the backend supports them.

query.description: The search query to look up on the web. You may include backend-supported operators such as site:example.com, filetype:pdf, intitle:word, -term, or "exact phrase".

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 5.
